name: frames-linescore
description: A Streamer.bot-native line-score board for OBS: team names, innings, per-inning scores and a total, driven from chat, Stream Deck, hotkeys, or a browser control panel. No dedicated server.
author: Ashe "Flash" Galatine
comment: verify:render and shots also need playwright-core (uses system Edge/Chrome): npm install --no-save playwright-core
